name: Pork grilled in leaves
summary: Minced pork shoulder wrapped in many layers of leaf and grilled. The culture desk says the leaf dries at the edge and the meat turns the yellow it describes. A dipping sauce and a price are Check on arrival.
origin: Dien Bien Phu. The culture desk’s 23 Mar 2020 list is the account. It calls the plate a Thái dish and does not name a shop.
taste: The culture desk says the seasoning and the sweet, deep pork meet, and that the cooked meat is yellow, with the outer leaf dry rather than burnt through.
howToEat: Mince pork shoulder, season it without covering the pork, wrap it in many layers of leaf, and grill it over charcoal until the meat is even and yellow and the outer leaf is dry.
Eat it from the leaf, hot. A dipping sauce was not named. A price and a daily stall are Check on arrival.
where: The Thái table. No shop and no street were printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Nhua pho in Dien Bien Phu — pork grilled in leaves
